home.intro1: Welcome to Groen Geluk vzw! Whether you've known us for a while or just discovered us, you are very welcome. Family, student, group of friends or on your own, young or old, everyone feels at home here.
home.intro2: Feel free to join us at the table and discover how we try to make the world a little more beautiful with honest, plant-based dishes. Thanks for being here.

about.title: About Groen Geluk
about.paragraph1: Groen Geluk is a community initiative in Belgium (e.g. in Leuven etc.) that focuses on sustainable, social, and plant-based experiences centered around eating and gathering together. The organization promotes local, organic, and seasonal plant-based food, with communal meals and activities at its core.
about.paragraph2: At events such as communal dinners, people from the neighborhood are brought together around one large table to enjoy healthy, plant-based dishes and encourage social connection. The project often operates as a non-profit or volunteer-driven initiative, aiming to promote sustainability, community, and a positive, green lifestyle.
about.watWedoenLeft1: Groen Geluk started a few years ago in Leuven from a shared dream to bring people together around delicious, plant-based food. What began as a shared passion has grown into a close-knit and driven team that regularly organises dinners, long tables and workshops.
about.watWedoenRight: Since 2026 we are officially Groen Geluk vzw; on paper just a little different, but we have simply remained our cozy bunch. We all believe that the richest conversations and the most beautiful connections arise when we sit down together at a table full of colorful plates. With our work we want to set things in motion in a positive way. We work with three concepts within which we organise dinners, long tables and workshops. The proceeds of these editions go each month to a different good cause that works for people and planet.
about.missieLeft: Groen Geluk wants to make healthy, sustainable food accessible to everyone. We organise solidary dinners and workshops that connect, sensitise and inspire people from all walks of life. By working together with local farmers and organisations we strengthen and promote the short supply chain, support social and ecological initiatives and show that plant-based food can be simple, affordable and delicious.
about.missieRight: We dream of a society in which food is not only healthy and sustainable, but also a source of solidarity and connection. Groen Geluk wants to be a catalyst for change: an organisation that brings farmer and citizen closer together, offers quality seasonal meals to everyone regardless of financial means, and raises awareness about the role of food in a more just and ecologically responsible world.

news.intro: On this page we happily share all our small and big stories. From fascinating conversations with partners and the engaged faces behind the good cause of the month, to our view on what is moving in the world and our favourite seasonal recipes.

calendar.intro1: Every month we alternately organise a buffet at the Stelplaats or a cozy dinner at the Maakleerplek, as well as a cooking workshop. Occasionally we go on location with Groen Geluk and cook by invitation and in collaboration.
calendar.intro2: In this overview you will discover where and when you can take a seat in the coming period for a clean plate of Groen Geluk. Click through to an event for all practical information. You will find the registration link both on the event page itself and in the bio on our Instagram.

calendar.intro3: Let us know in advance via the registration form. We always try to take this into account as much as possible in the kitchen, although unfortunately we cannot always give a hundred percent guarantee.

werking.intro: From our mission and vision three different concepts emerged. Always in one of our fixed bases in Leuven: the Stelplaats and the Maakleerplek. Occasionally we go on location with Groen Geluk and cook by invitation and in collaboration; this is clearly stated on the event page of each edition.
werking.tafelText1: Sometimes it may be wonderfully lively! For these editions we immerse you in the relaxed energy of a well-stocked, delicious buffet. You simply walk in, take a seat and enjoy plates of comfort food for a free contribution.
werking.tafelText2: We always communicate in advance what the average costs for a plate are. You then pay what you can or want to give yourself: everything you give on top of the costs goes directly to the good cause of that month. Drinks are ordered and paid separately at the bar. The proceeds of those do go directly to Groen Geluk's own organisation.
werking.dinerText1: For those who prefer it a little more 'chic' and snug, we organise our 3-course dinners at the Maakleerplek. We provide a cozy restaurant setting where you can sit down quietly for a delicious plant-based menu. Here we work with a sliding scale where you choose what you can or want to pay: social rate (15 euros), solidary rate (40 euros) or basic rate (25 euros). Here too you get drinks separately at the bar for the benefit of our own vzw organisation.
werking.workshopsText1: Once a month we organise a small-scale cooking workshop for a group of about 10 people. Here we gladly pass on our knowledge of the plant-based kitchen, so you discover how easy it is to get started at home yourself. We work with a sliding scale for registrations: social rate (26 euros), basic rate (32 euros) and solidary rate (38 euros).
werking.workshopsText2: The workshops are not meant to generate income for us. If we do make a profit from them, it goes entirely to our general organisation.

support.title: Support us with a donation!
support.left: We put all our time, love and energy into cooking for our monthly good causes. Groen Geluk runs entirely on voluntary effort: even our fixed team is not compensated. To be able to keep doing all this and keep our editions and workshops accessible, our own organisation occasionally needs a little extra breathing room.
support.right: Do you want to help us cover the fixed costs, renew kitchen equipment or simply let our concept grow? Then you can help us enormously with a free donation. Every amount, big or small, flows directly back into the general operations of Groen Geluk, so that we can keep cooking with just as much enthusiasm for a better world. Many thanks for your support!

volunteers.title: Help as a volunteer!
volunteers.left: Groen Geluk runs entirely on our warm group of volunteers. Fancy rolling up your sleeves too? Leave your details below and we will add you to our WhatsApp group in which we share all shifts and calls. If you come to help, you are always welcome to take a seat for a free plate of Groen Geluk.
volunteers.right: Whether you help in the kitchen, dive into the room with the guests or help with the dishes afterwards: all hands are more than welcome. You absolutely need no experience; the desire to create something beautiful together is more than enough. Welcome to our team!

cause.title: Good cause of the month
cause.left: At Groen Geluk cooking is never a goal in itself, but a powerful means to set change in motion. Every month we put our shoulders under one specific good cause that shares our values and works hard for a warmer, fairer world. We do not only do that by donating our proceeds. At every edition we actively seek collaboration with that month's organisation. You will therefore find the people behind the good cause with us on the floor: they cook along in the kitchen, help serve or join us at the table.
cause.right: So by coming to eat with us you not only contribute directly to their organisation, but you also get to know the face and the story behind the initiative a little better.
cause.featuredLeft: In September we shine the spotlight, with a lot of love, on Compagnie Cordial. Compagnie Cordial vzw builds a wonderful bridge between newcomers in Belgium and local organisations. They help new residents find meaningful volunteer work and connect them with organisations that want to become more inclusive. Through volunteering, newcomers get the chance to practise Dutch in a pleasant way, discover the city and build a new network. At the same time, organisations are enriched with engaged forces and become a better reflection of our diverse society. (©️Compagnie Cordial vzw) Meeting at eye level and rolling up our sleeves together fits seamlessly with what Groen Geluk stands for.
